# Agent Python Tools

## File: facebookresearch_depthcontrast/third_party/OpenPCDet/pcdet/ops/iou3d_nms/iou3d_nms_utils.py

Prompts

```
["build a python module to compute bird's eye view IoU between two sets of 3D boxes on CPU", "build a python module to compute bird's eye view IoU between two sets of 3D boxes on GPU", 'build a python module to compute full 3D IoU between two sets of 3D oriented boxes on GPU', 'run rotated 3D NMS on a set of 3D boxes with scores and an IoU threshold on GPU', 'run standard 3D NMS on a set of 3D boxes with scores and an IoU threshold on GPU']
```

Usage

```
{'build_bev_iou_cpu': "build a python module to compute bird's eye view IoU between two sets of 3D boxes on CPU", 'build_bev_iou_gpu': "build a python module to compute bird's eye view IoU between two sets of 3D boxes on GPU", 'build_iou3d_gpu': 'build a python module to compute full 3D IoU between two sets of 3D oriented boxes on GPU', 'run_nms_gpu': 'run rotated 3D NMS on a set of 3D boxes with scores and an IoU threshold on GPU', 'run_nms_normal_gpu': 'run standard 3D NMS on a set of 3D boxes with scores and an IoU threshold on GPU'}
```
